contract: A road user's heading is turning to the left at the observation: its yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate, positive to the left, counter-clockwise) exceeds `tol`, a tolerance that names only the source's yaw-rate resolution, whether the road user moves forwards or backwards. Not denoted: a heading turning to the right or not changing; the angle turned or a completed turn; where the turn is made, which the caller states. The concept does not tell a turn at a junction from a lane change or a bend; the caller's place condition does.

params.name: tol
params.meaning: the source's yaw-rate resolution: a yaw rate at or below it is read as no turning to the left

elements.span: its yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate, positive to the left, counter-clockwise) exceeds `tol`
elements.justification: kin.yaw_rate is the 'rate of change of heading, positive when the heading turns to the left (counter-clockwise)'; its exclusion 'not a stand-in for road curvature' is respected: the concept states a heading change, not a road shape, and leaves the place to the caller.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: x's kin.yaw_rate is +12 deg/s with tol 2 deg/s: turning left.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: x's kin.yaw_rate is -12 deg/s: turning right.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: kin.yaw_rate is not observed for x.

differs_from.why: drv.motion.turning reads the magnitude of the yaw rate, a turn to either hand; this concept reads its sign, a turn to the left only.
